text_block_list.text:
On our way back together, El Condor Pasa's 
phone rang.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is big news!! A 
pro-wrestling site's breaking news just 
reported...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El Condor is retiring?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just why... I'm still right in the middle 
of proving I'm the strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure about that yet, but... it is 
a trustworthy fan site.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm... going to go ask them myself! Their 
agency shouldn't be too far from here!

If it hasn't been officially made public, 
they probably won't answer even if asked. 
However—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I just have to know, yes I do...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Elikondor is El's rival, you know!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just El's one-sided 
feelings... she was the one in the ring 
who made me feel that way!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So... that's why...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! Thank you very much, Trainer!"

...Elikondor wasn't at the office. 
Apparently, she had already left for 
training in preparation for her next 
match.

text_block_list.name: Agency Staff
text_block_list.text:
She went running toward the riverbed just 
a little while ago, but where could she be 
now...?

text_block_list.name: Agency Staff
text_block_list.text:
I don't plan on heading back today. 
Besides, training camp starts tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Agency Staff
text_block_list.text:
As for the retirement news... I think 
you'll see from the race... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The next match... will that be your 
retirement match?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To El, she might be a rival, but to El 
Condor, she's just a fan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it can't be helped, having to wait 
until the next match... is terribly 
painful, yes.

According to the agency staff, El Condor 
Pasa just left a moment ago. In that case—
choice_data_list: I might be able to catch up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ! T-That's right, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
They might be nearby, or maybe still over 
by the riverbank!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer!

—However, even after searching until 
nightfall, El Condor was nowhere to be 
found.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for coming along with me, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We couldn't find El Condor, but... still.

Is she feeling down? I wondered if I 
should comfort her, but the look in El 
Condor Pasa's eyes was—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if she gives up on her dream, 
mine will not change."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Not just El Condor, even if other rivals 
leave as well—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El... El Condor Pasa will keep flying 
forever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Turning the courage and passion that so 
many rivals gave El into power!!

She was burning with a fiery fighting 
spirit.
choice_data_list: I'm sure she has her reasons too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, you're right. To have to give up on 
your dreams, such painful circumstances...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure everything will become clear 
in the next race! Let's wait for more info 
for now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten quite late, hasn't it? Let's 
head back, Trainer!

Giving just a faint, clumsy smile, El 
Condor Pasa kept her eyes firmly set on 
what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
True, they did say she just left! We might 
still be able to catch up to her...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's head down to the 
riverbank!!

I arrived at the riverbank, but El Condor 
Pasa was nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's further ahead...! I'll go look 
over that way too!"

We searched around for a while after that, 
but we couldn't find Helicondor. Night had 
completely fallen by then—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...! I'll go check somewhere else!
choice_data_list: I have to get back now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still, I just can't give up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El Condor said she'd prove it! Just like 
El would! And yet!
choice_data_list: Do you really think I've given up?
Do you really think I gave up?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

The powerful words and voice of El Condor 
when we met at the station before. I 
simply cannot believe those were a lie.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...YES, dat is right. She said... she 
would 'stand at the summit of the World 
Championship.'

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious about the reason, but I'll 
believe in the words she said back then!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will do what El has to do! To prove I'm 
the world's strongest!

Though she wasn't completely refreshed, El 
Condor Pasa still faced forward and began 
walking ahead.
